The lineup

Four apps. One promise.

Every RMDevelopers app is free on Google Play and built to work beautifully on everyday Android phones.

01/04App · Finance

ArthZen

A calmer relationship with your money.

A private, local-first ledger for everyday money. Record income and expenses by hand, set an essential-spending budget, plan your savings and understand it all through simple, explainable summaries — without ever connecting a bank account.

  • Never connects to your bank or reads SMS
  • Budgets and savings plans with clear arithmetic
  • Records stored locally, optional cloud backup
  • Export to CSV or a full backup anytime
Get it on Google Play

02/04App · Productivity

Local Notes

Notes that stay on your phone.

A private, offline notepad. Type or dictate, colour-code what matters, attach photos and keep everything on your device. No account, no cloud, no sign-up — and it speaks nine languages.

  • Voice notes in 10 Indian & global languages
  • Colours, tags, pins and instant search
  • Up to 8 photos per note
  • Works fully offline — no Local Notes server
Get it on Google Play

03/04Game · Racing

LaneZing

Twist the throttle. Thread the traffic.

Highway bike racing built for speed. Split lanes between cars, buses and trucks, race superbikes on GP circuits and get muddy on dirt tracks — through day, night and monsoon rain. Plays fully offline.

  • Endless highway, GP circuits and dirt racing
  • 17 motorcycles with upgradeable garages
  • Day, night and monsoon rain on wet roads
  • Tilt or touch controls, no internet needed
Get it on Google Play Game site

04/04Game · Puzzle

Patang Pop

Which kite can fly first?

A colourful kite puzzle. Follow each kite's arrow, tap when its path is clear and empty the sky in the right order. 500 hand-shaped offline levels, endless random skies and no time limit — at your own pace.

  • 500 offline puzzles, all in the download
  • No time limit, free undo, saved hints
  • Endless random skies — always solvable
  • Unlock kite colours, no purchases
Get it on Google Play Game site Privacy

How we build

Made with intent.

01

Offline when it matters

Notes, races and puzzles work with no connection. Your phone is the product, not a thin window onto a server.

02

Private by default

Records, notes and voice transcripts live on your device. We never read your bank messages or ask for more than a feature needs.

03

Respect for your time

No forced sign-ups, no countdown pressure, no maze of menus. Open the app and get on with it.

04

Built for India and beyond

Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian and more — apps that speak the way you do.

Questions

Good to know.

Who is RMDevelopers?

RMDevelopers is the independent Android studio of Rohit Madas, a frontend and mobile engineer based in Pune, India. We design and ship small, private, offline-first apps and games.

Are the apps free?

Yes. All four are free to download on Google Play. Some are supported by ads, and ArthZen offers an optional Premium plan for deeper analysis and an ad-free experience.

Do the apps need an internet connection?

Mostly no. Local Notes, LaneZing and Patang Pop work fully offline. ArthZen keeps your records on the device and only goes online for optional cloud backup.

Where is my data stored?

On your phone. Local Notes has no server at all, and ArthZen never connects to your bank. Each app's Google Play listing links to its full privacy policy.

How do I report a bug or suggest a feature?

Use the developer contact on any app's Google Play listing, or reach out on LinkedIn. Every message is read.
